description: Connects a dietary supplement blend to an enzyme activity class represented among its non-botanical ingredient components. The target describes enzyme activity rather than a specific protein.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the relationship was created or last updated.

common_properties.name: category
common_properties.description: NHANES ingredient category: Vitamin, Mineral, Other, or Amino acid. When contributing components of differing categories refer to the same blend and enzyme activity class, the category is Other.
common_properties.notes: scalar; exactly one of "Vitamin", "Mineral", "Other", "Amino acid"; Always present

source_contributions.scope: Non-botanical components in the NHANES Dietary Supplement Ingredient File (DSBI): Vitamin, Mineral, Other, and Amino acid categories. Botanical components are excluded. Coverage is limited to components resolved to existing EC nodes and blends present in SPOKE.
source_contributions.description: Records containment of enzyme activity classes listed as supplement-blend components, with one relationship per blend and EC pair. Unresolved components are absent from these relationships.
